title: Ali's House
text:
My friend Ali has a small house. The house is blue and white. It has two windows and a red door. There is a big tree in the garden.

Ali's dog is brown and very friendly. His name is Max. Max likes to run in the garden. He is always happy when Ali comes home.

questions.text: What is the name of Ali's dog?
What can we guess about Ali?
options: He lives in a city apartment

questions.text: Why is Max probably a good pet for Ali?
options: He is friendly and he likes the garden

vocabulary.definition: a piece of land near a house where plants or trees grow
kind and pleasant to other people or animals
a tall plant with a trunk, branches and leaves
openings in a wall that let light and air into a building

paragraph_translations: Arkadaşım Ali'nin küçük bir evi var. Ev mavi ve beyaz. İki pencere ve kırmızı bir kapısı var. Bahçede büyük bir ağaç var.
Ali'nin köpeği kahverengi ve çok samimi. Adı Max. Max bahçede koşmayı sever. Ali eve geldiğinde her zaman mutlu olur.
